thread:
Alex: Hey team — FinCorp (prospect) asked for full pen-test evidence + a remediation timeline. I uploaded initial bundle here: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-sec/fincorp-pt-1850001234.zip. Customer asks for: 1) prioritized vuln list (critical/high), 2) owners + ETA for fixes, 3) sanitized evidence for their legal/compliance review. Can we get a draft by Wed EOD?

Maria: Got it. I'll pull the Nessus + Burp exports and start mapping to assets. Will mark severity and reproducibility. Aiming for initial triage by Wed noon. :white_check_mark:

Samir: I started a quick review — the highest-severity item looks like a deserialization issue in our protobuf handling lib (CVE-2025-4321). Patch is available in upstream v1.2.3. I can cut a hotfix branch tomorrow and prep a deploy. Tentative ETA 48h for full rollout (depends on canary results).

Jess: I'll assemble the customer-facing readout and a redacted evidence packet. Suggest we strip internal hostnames/IPs and only include repro steps + sanitized logs. If you confirm which logs to include I can produce the PDF draft.

security-bot: New external scan artifact uploaded by ops at 1850001250 — location: gs://redwood-sec-scans/1850001250/nessus-export.json

Alex: Also FinCorp specifically asked whether exploits require auth or network access. Please add a short note per vuln (requires-auth / network-exploit-able).

Maria: Will add columns "requires-auth" and "exploit-requires-network" to the triage sheet. Also adding business impact text to top 10. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example-fincorp-triage/edit (redacted link).

Samir: Notes for the top items: CVE-2025-4321 — requires authenticated admin API access and a valid session token (exploit vector is admin endpoint). Mitigation: upgrade to protobuf v1.2.3 + block admin endpoints with temporary WAF rule. Patch deploy ~6h, key rotation ~1h for service tokens. Owner: Samir.

Jess: I scheduled a customer readout for Thurs 11:00am PST (invites out to FinCorp CISO + infra lead). Agenda draft: quick summary, top 5 remediations + ETA, evidence bundle, Q&A. Alex please confirm.

Alex: Confirmed. I'll invite their security + infra. Please have the prioritized list and redacted evidence by Wed EOD so legal can review before Thurs.

Maria: Uploaded triage spreadsheet and marked the top 8 items with owners and recommended fixes. I redacted internal hostnames per Jess's guideline. New columns: id, severity, cve, affected_component, repro_steps, requires_auth, exploit_network, recommended_fix, owner, eta.

Samir: Created PR for hotfix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789 — includes protobuf upgrade + unit tests. CI green locally, running full pipeline.

Jess: Draft readout PDF in drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0A-example-fincorp-readout — filename fincorp-readout-draft-v1.pdf. Added redaction notes and a short explainer slide about exploit scope. Feedback welcome.

Alex: Legal asked for proof that pen-test NDA is signed on our side. FinCorp said they signed on their end. I attached our signed copy to the sheet.

Maria: Ops suggestion: deploy temporary WAF rule to block admin endpoints until patch is live. Low risk and reduces attack surface for the readout window.

Jordan: Ops here — rolling out the WAF rule now. Will monitor for false positives. ETA 30m.

Jordan: WAF rule deployed at 1850001290. No customer impact observed in the last 10m. Posting logs to the folder for the evidence bundle.

Alex: Awesome — thanks all. Next sync Wed 09:00am PT to confirm triage and finalize the PDF for legal. If anything slips, ping me @alex. :thumbsup:
